raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated different women named “Julia Caesaris,” incorrectly suggesting that Marcus Atius Balbus could be an alternative spouse of Cornelia’s daughter. In fact, Marcus Atius Balbus married Julia Minor (Julius Caesar’s sister), not Julia, daughter of Julius Caesar and Cornelia. This misidentification introduced an incorrect potential child-in-law and reflects a failure to disambiguate common Roman names and verify sources.
